Condition: If 4 Bergmännlein have collected Ore Counters druing a Play Maker session: Transform Belial
Ultimate Side: Your Basic Ability is still active and usable. Every mine gives +2 Ore instead of +1. Once per cycle: Consume 3 Ore: give one earth unit +2 Base Power during combat.
